issues.detail: In Example 2, 「損金算入を認めるため」 creates an unnatural agent-predicate mismatch with the board resolution. Tax authorities recognize deductions, whereas the company seeks qualification (e.g., 「損金算入が認められるよう」 or 「損金算入要件を満たすため」).
